interpretation_guardrails: Pool-size contrasts are paired within initialization seed.
Sample SD describes the observed initialization seeds; it is not a confidence interval.
One-pass tune, fixed-budget tune, and selected-checkpoint legacy-eval rows are distinct estimands.
Optional geometry metrics condition on fixed legacy-evaluation subsets.
Optional retrieval recall is a strict original-ID metric on public queries.

design.favorable_delta_definition: delta for higher-is-better metrics; negated delta for lower-is-better metrics
design.paired_delta_definition: pool value minus largest-pool value within seed

metric_catalog.definition: Tune-set reconstruction MSE divided by mean-predictor MSE immediately after one complete pass over the arm's training pool.
Mean tune-set cosine similarity immediately after one complete pass over the arm's training pool.
Tune-set normalized reconstruction MSE after the common fixed optimizer-update budget, irrespective of the checkpoint selected for final evaluation.
Mean tune-set cosine similarity after the common fixed optimizer-update budget.
Normalized reconstruction MSE on the common legacy evaluation cohort, measured once after tune-only checkpoint selection.
Mean cosine similarity on the common legacy evaluation cohort, measured once after tune-only checkpoint selection.
Sample-conditional trustworthiness on the fixed geometry sample.
Sample-conditional continuity on the fixed geometry sample.
Spearman correlation of original and encoded distances on fixed sampled pairs.
Scale-fitted normalized stress on fixed sampled pairs.
Distance-weighted kNN reconstruction NMSE on the fixed decoder sample.
Strict original-ID intersection recall at cutoff 10 on the common public Deep1B query prefix.
Strict original-ID intersection recall at cutoff 100 on the common public Deep1B query prefix.
